stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Work my rate out in one place.

stations.title: The old bill
stations.text: The same sums copied, and one copy is wrong.

captions: Ambrose wants his rate worked out in one place, and every bill line to ask it.
Today the same sums are copied around the bill, and last year one was missed.
You write functions that take values and give one back, in four tasks.
Now each sum lives in one function, and the bill calls it wherever it is needed.
Functions work on copies, though. Next, Kasimir needs one that changes his count.
